The '''Woteba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Utegetu Nebula/Legends|Utegetu Nebula]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Woteba]].
